mapper.select: SELECT p.*, v.plan_version_id, v.version_no, v.status version_status FROM biz_python_practice_plan p LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_id=p.plan_id AND v.version_no=IF(p.current_version_no=0,(SELECT MAX(v2.version_no) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version v2 WHERE v2.plan_id=p.plan_id),p.current_version_no) WHERE p.dept_id=#{deptId} AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.entry_year=#{entryYear} ORDER BY p.grade, p.plan_id

SELECT p.*,v.plan_version_id,v.version_no,v.status version_status FROM biz_python_practice_plan p LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_id=p.plan_id AND v.version_no=IF(p.current_version_no=0,(SELECT MAX(v2.version_no) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version v2 WHERE v2.plan_id=p.plan_id),p.current_version_no) WHERE p.plan_id=#{planId}
SELECT * FROM biz_python_practice_plan WHERE dept_id=#{deptId} AND grade=#{grade} AND semester=#{semester} AND entry_year=#{entryYear} AND status='ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT p.*,v.plan_version_id,v.version_no,v.status version_status FROM biz_python_practice_plan p JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_id=p.plan_id WHERE v.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId}

SELECT q.plan_question_id,q.question_id,q.sort_no,q.stage,q.required_flag,s.snapshot_id,s.question_content,s.input_description,s.output_description,s.sample_explanation,s.constraints_text,s.notes_text,s.starter_code,s.language_code,s.time_limit_seconds,s.memory_limit_kb FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=q.snapshot_id WHERE q.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} ORDER BY q.sort_no

SELECT 'BASE_VERSION' source_type,v.plan_version_id source_id,q.question_id,q.sort_no,q.stage,q.required_flag,s.snapshot_id,s.question_content,s.input_description,s.output_description,s.sample_explanation,s.constraints_text,s.notes_text,s.starter_code,s.language_code,s.time_limit_seconds,s.memory_limit_kb FROM biz_python_practice_plan p JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_id=p.plan_id AND v.status='PUBLISHED' AND v.version_no=p.current_version_no JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_question q ON q.plan_version_id=v.plan_version_id JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=q.snapshot_id WHERE p.dept_id=#{deptId} AND p.entry_year=#{entryYear} AND p.status='ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT 'EXTENSION',e.extension_id,q.question_id,q.sort_no,'EXTENSION','1',s.snapshot_id,s.question_content,s.input_description,s.output_description,s.sample_explanation,s.constraints_text,s.notes_text,s.starter_code,s.language_code,s.time_limit_seconds,s.memory_limit_kb FROM biz_python_practice_extension e JOIN biz_python_practice_extension_class ec ON ec.extension_id=e.extension_id AND ec.dept_id=#{deptId} AND ec.entry_year=#{entryYear} AND ec.class_code=#{classCode} JOIN biz_python_practice_extension_question q ON q.extension_id=e.extension_id JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=q.snapshot_id WHERE e.status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY sort_no
SELECT s.* FROM biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s WHERE s.source_type=#{sourceType} AND s.source_id=#{sourceId} AND s.question_id=#{questionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM biz_python_practice_draft WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_python_practice_draft(student_id,source_type,source_id,question_id,snapshot_id,source_code,update_time) VALUES(#{studentId},#{sourceType},#{sourceId},#{questionId},#{snapshotId},#{sourceCode},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE snapshot_id=VALUES(snapshot_id),source_code=VALUES(source_code),update_time=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT submission_id,submission_key,source_type,source_id,question_id,submit_type,status_code,status_message,score,passed_case_count,total_case_count,judge_summary,submitted_at,judged_at FROM biz_python_practice_submission WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND question_id=#{questionId} ORDER BY submission_id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM biz_python_practice_submission WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId}
SELECT * FROM biz_python_practice_snapshot_case WHERE snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND is_public='1' ORDER BY order_num
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_python_practice_submission SET status_code='JUDGING',status_message='判题中' WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND status_code='WAITING'

UPDATE biz_python_practice_submission SET status_code=#{statusCode},status_message=#{statusMessage},score=#{score},passed_case_count=#{passedCaseCount},total_case_count=#{totalCaseCount},judge_summary=#{judgeSummary},judged_at=NOW() WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} AND status_code IN ('WAITING','JUDGING')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_python_practice_plan SET status=#{status},update_time=NOW() WHERE plan_id=#{planId}

UPDATE biz_python_practice_plan_version SET status='RETRACTED',update_time=NOW() WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND (#{exceptVersionId} IS NULL OR plan_version_id <> #{exceptVersionId})
UPDATE biz_python_practice_plan_version SET status='PUBLISHED',published_time=NOW(),update_time=NOW() WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','PUBLISHED')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.snapshot_id) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_snapshot_case c ON c.snapshot_id=q.snapshot_id WHERE q.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND c.is_public='1''0'
SELECT version_no FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version WHERE plan_version_id=#{planVersionId}

SELECT e.*,COUNT(eq.extension_question_id) question_count FROM biz_python_practice_extension e LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_extension_question eq ON eq.extension_id=e.extension_id WHERE e.plan_id=#{planId} GROUP BY e.extension_id ORDER BY e.extension_id DESC
SELECT * FROM biz_python_practice_extension WHERE extension_id=#{extensionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_python_practice_extension_class(extension_id,dept_id,entry_year,class_code) VALUES(#{extensionId},#{deptId},#{entryYear},#{classCode}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE class_code=VALUES(class_code)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_plan_version WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.delete: DELETE c FROM biz_python_practice_snapshot_case c JOIN biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=c.snapshot_id LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON s.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND s.source_id=v.plan_version_id LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_extension e ON s.source_type='EXTENSION' AND s.source_id=e.extension_id WHERE v.plan_id=#{planId} OR e.plan_id=#{planId}

DELETE s FROM biz_python_practice_question_snapshot s LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON s.source_type='BASE_VERSION' AND s.source_id=v.plan_version_id LEFT JOIN biz_python_practice_extension e ON s.source_type='EXTENSION' AND s.source_id=e.extension_id WHERE v.plan_id=#{planId} OR e.plan_id=#{planId}
DELETE q FROM biz_python_practice_plan_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_version_id=q.plan_version_id WHERE v.plan_id=#{planId}
DELETE q FROM biz_python_practice_extension_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_extension e ON e.extension_id=q.extension_id WHERE e.plan_id=#{planId}
DELETE c FROM biz_python_practice_extension_class c JOIN biz_python_practice_extension e ON e.extension_id=c.extension_id WHERE e.plan_id=#{planId}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_python_practice_extension SET status='PUBLISHED',published_time=NOW(),update_time=NOW() WHERE extension_id=#{extensionId} AND status='DRAFT'
UPDATE biz_python_practice_extension SET status='RETRACTED',update_time=NOW() WHERE extension_id=#{extensionId} AND status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_extension_question WHERE extension_id=#{extensionId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.snapshot_id) FROM biz_python_practice_extension_question q JOIN biz_python_practice_snapshot_case c ON c.snapshot_id=q.snapshot_id WHERE q.extension_id=#{extensionId} AND c.is_public='1''0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_extension_question WHERE extension_id=#{extensionId} AND question_id=#{questionId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_python_practice_extension target JOIN biz_python_practice_extension_class target_class ON target_class.extension_id=target.extension_id JOIN biz_python_practice_extension other ON other.plan_id=target.plan_id AND other.status='PUBLISHED' AND other.extension_id<>target.extension_id JOIN biz_python_practice_extension_class other_class ON other_class.extension_id=other.extension_id AND other_class.dept_id=target_class.dept_id AND other_class.entry_year=target_class.entry_year AND other_class.class_code=target_class.class_code JOIN biz_python_practice_extension_question other_question ON other_question.extension_id=other.extension_id AND other_question.question_id=#{questionId} WHERE target.extension_id=#{extensionId}

SELECT p.student_id,s.student_no,u.nick_name student_name,s.entry_year,s.class_code,p.question_id,p.best_score,p.passed_flag,p.submit_count,p.first_pass_time,p.last_practice_time FROM biz_python_practice_progress p JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=p.student_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE p.source_type=#{sourceType} AND p.source_id=#{sourceId} AND u.dept_id=#{deptId} AND s.entry_year=#{entryYear} AND s.class_code=#{classCode} ORDER BY s.class_code,s.student_no,p.last_practice_time DESC
SELECT source_type,source_id,question_id,best_score,passed_flag,submit_count,first_pass_time,last_practice_time FROM biz_python_practice_progress WHERE student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_python_practice_progress(student_id,source_type,source_id,question_id,best_score,passed_flag,submit_count,first_pass_time,last_practice_time) VALUES(#{studentId},#{sourceType},#{sourceId},#{questionId},#{bestScore},#{passedFlag},1,#{firstPassTime},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE best_score=GREATEST(best_score,VALUES(best_score)),passed_flag=IF(VALUES(passed_flag)='1','1',passed_flag),submit_count=submit_count+1,first_pass_time=IF(first_pass_time IS NULL,VALUES(first_pass_time),first_pass_time),last_practice_time=NOW()
